svg.title: Virtual desktops with Amazon WorkSpaces
svg.desc: Virtual desktops with Amazon WorkSpaces. 9 components in 6 groups. Connections: WorkSpaces client to Amazon WorkSpaces (stream); WorkSpaces client to Amazon WorkSpaces (stream); Amazon WorkSpaces to AWS Managed Microsoft AD (sign in); Amazon WorkSpaces to AWS Managed Microsoft AD (sign in); Amazon WorkSpaces to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server (home folders); Amazon WorkSpaces to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server (home folders); AWS Managed Microsoft AD to AWS Site-to-Site VPN (trust traffic); AWS Managed Microsoft AD to AWS Site-to-Site VPN (trust traffic); AWS Site-to-Site VPN to Active Directory (AD trust).

text.tspan: Desktops in two Availability Zones sign in through AWS Managed Microsoft AD, which trusts the corporate domain
